input.prompt: Create an original 38.167-second upbeat electronic instrumental at118 BPM for a playful precise motion-graphics film. Clean nu-disco-leaning electronic groove with rounded synth bass, tight four-on-the-floor kick, light crisp clap/snare, shaker and dry closed hi-hats. A small memorable but unobtrusive staccato pluck-synth motif, a few airy warm pads underneath, light syncopated percussive detail. Build quickly in the first3 seconds, keep buoyant momentum, briefly open texture near21–26 seconds and lightly increase shuffling percussion near32–35. Finish with a soft short resolution by38 seconds. Leave space for separately timed pops and whooshes. No vocals, no vocal chops, no speech, no sound effects. Compose new melody and chords.
